description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Sales/MarkAsDispatched. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Acknowledges in HGR that an order-dispatch warning was handled manually for one exact order line. ownerAgent: orders-autoordering. Domain: orders. Entity: order_line. Operation: acknowledge_manual_dispatch. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use only when the user explicitly wants to clear the HGR warning after manually handling dispatch in the marketplace. Input: [FromBody] rq: AddAutoOrderReferenceRequest. Main field: OrderLineId: int. Required Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Marks the dispatch warning as acknowledged in HGR and returns whether the order line was updated. Search terms: sales markasdispatched. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_sales_markasdispatched
title: Post Sales Markasdispatched
